traditional_baseline_contract.evidence_gated_follow_the_leader_formula: WWM if matured_mean(v4_squared_error - WWM_squared_error) > 1.96 * standard_error else v4
traditional_baseline_contract.external_regret_definition: algorithm cumulative squared loss minus the smaller cumulative squared loss of fixed v4 or fixed WWM at each issue-time prefix

warmup_ablation_formulas.coefficient_lcb_blend: v4 + clip(raw_weight - 1.96 * weight_standard_error, 0, 1) * (WWM - v4) after 24 matured samples
warmup_ablation_formulas.loss_gated_lcb_blend: coefficient_lcb_blend only while the matured paired-loss Follow-the-Leader evidence gate selects WWM; otherwise v4
warmup_ablation_formulas.loss_gated_ols_blend: v4 + clip(raw_weight, 0, 1) * (WWM - v4) only while the matured paired-loss Follow-the-Leader evidence gate selects WWM
